text: A free-text note on an epic overlaps the comments feature that the architecture puts out of scope (AD-09).
'Only the PM can edit a note' contradicts 'every project member can edit notes they can see'.
'A short note' gives no length limit.
'Recent notes' is not defined (how many, how recent, ordered by what).
The screen belongs under src/fe and the endpoint under src/be (C8), not apps/web and apps/api.
Nothing says what happens to a pinned note when its epic is closed or deleted.
Visibility to a member of any project breaks the project boundary (AD-55 policy map, NotMember).
